headline: Constants for Excalidraw application behavior
what_breaks: packages/common/src/index.ts — relies on constants for app configuration
packages/common/src/utils.ts — uses constants for utility functions
why: This file defines critical constants that affect the overall behavior and configuration of the Excalidraw application. Changes here can impact multiple components and utilities across the project, leading to potential runtime errors or unexpected behavior.
checklist: Review changes to constants affecting UI behavior
Ensure any new constants are exported for use in dependent files
Verify that modifications do not conflict with existing constants in utils or font-metadata
